ns2:section.sectionText: This course will survey the trends and tendencies within the context of American cinema in the 1990s, as well as the industry from which they emerged. Rather than move chronologically through the decade, this course will approach the decade through an exploration of the significant movements within the industry and counter-movements that occurred in response. Along with mainstream filmmaking, the class will also look at independent filmmakers and the movements (New Queer Cinema, Diasporic filmmaking) that brought American independent cinema to a new position of prominence in the 1990s.
